I found Q3.4 about Absalon data quite hard to answer because tracking online activity feels intrusive. I understand it could help identify students needing support, but privacy concerns are significant.

The most important questions for model design are those about data use (Q3) and explainability (Q4). We need to balance accuracy with respecting student privacy and ensuring transparency in how decisions are made.

Our group's answers differed the most on race/ethnicity data. I chose "never acceptable" because it feels too sensitive, but others might argue its inclusion could help reduce inequalities. Perhaps an opt-out mechanism could address this tension by letting students choose whether to include such sensitive data.
I'd like to hear from others on how they view this trade-off.
